Not on his side, just facts on VR. To get a proper 3d image, they need to render the scene TWICE, from slightly different positions, which is quite taxing on the graphics processor in the console. This will either need resolution or graphical quality drops, as the console can't do the current graphical quality it does at that framerate, most releases at the moment are running at 30.
